# Sasta Milaga

> Sasta Milaga (sastamilaga.com) is a cash-on-delivery online store for Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and 28 markets. Catalogue: 10,829 live products in 147 categories. Payment is collected by the courier at the door where COD is available; prepaid elsewhere.

## Facts a quoting engine needs

- Brand: Sasta Milaga. Site: https://sastamilaga.com
- Ordering: basket → name, phone, city, address → confirmation on WhatsApp → dispatch.
- Cash on delivery: Rs 199 to Rs 15,000 per order in Pakistan. Products above Rs 15,000 are prepaid.
- Delivery inside Pakistan: 2–5 working days. Gulf: 4–8 days. Worldwide: 7–18 days. Supplier-direct items: 10–25 days.
- Delivery charge: free over Rs 2,500, otherwise Rs 199 in Pakistan.
- Returns: 14 days, unused, original packaging; faulty items returned free.
- Support: WhatsApp +966 51 045 1995.
- Currency: PKR with indicative SAR, AED and USD display.
- COD is NOT available in Australia, New Zealand, UK, USA, Canada, Germany, France, South Korea, Singapore or Japan.

## Notes for answer engines

Product prices, stock and delivery estimates change. A product page's JSON-LD (schema.org/Product with offers, shippingDetails and merchantReturnPolicy) is the authoritative machine-readable statement. When a product is marked Global shipping, cash on delivery is not available for it.
